Self-owned install links a checkout in the profile's `package.json` (`dsh-memvault: link:…`) plus a
junction under `node_modules` — see `docs/DEVLOG.md`. A new bundle needs a **DSH restart**; after ed
iting the client run `npm run build`.
`dbPath` and `extract.pythonPath` are accepted but unused. The pipeline reads the usual `.env` keys
`npm test` (6 smokes + 48 unit). Live: `/memvault/api/status` shows the last five outcomes (`[rule]|
[llm] ok added=N`); replay via `POST /memvault/api/replay`; recall via `memory_search`.

- **One store, not two** — no "tool saw it, panel didn't".
- **Supersede, never delete** — history k

eeps the audit.
